mentions.name: Grafly
mentions.description: A web-based diagramming app that runs entirely client-side with no server, persisting diagrams in localStorage. Supports downloading/uploading individual diagrams and the entire database, includes data structure descriptions so AI can generate diagrams, and imports Mermaid and other text-based diagram formats.
mentions.problem: The author disliked how existing web-based diagramming apps looked.
mentions.source_excerpt: I didn't like the way diagramming apps looked like (at least web based ones) so I built https://grafly.io.
